name: Shoujo Kakumei Utena ~Itsuka Kakumeisareru Monogatari~
original_name: 少女革命ウテナ いつか革命される物語
source:
A side story of the Shoujo Kakumei Utena, set between episodes 8 and 9 of the TV series.

The protagonist is a female student who transfers to Ohtori Academy and becomes involved with the political intrigue and sword duels that characterise it.
translation:
